question: the three battle plan functions both readers left to the other

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager_LoadToolSettings
addresses.no_signature: its arguments were read through its callers and not set down
addresses.comment: Reads battleplans/bp_settings.txt into a fresh settings object, the mod's file where the directory mode gives it (mode 1 the mod's only, mode 2 the mod's if it exists, else the install's), the old object freed, so a reload loses the current tool and options. Called from CBattlePlanManager::Reload.
addresses.evidence: Read by the wave's two readers, each of whom left its entry to the other; see the write-ups.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnTextApply
addresses.no_signature: its arguments were read through its callers and not set down
addresses.comment: The text prompt's `apply`. A selected arrow takes the box as its label (empty removes it); otherwise a selected text sign takes it (empty deletes the sign and the tool returns to select); otherwise, nothing selected, an empty box returns the tool to select and any other is stored for the next sign placed.
addresses.evidence: Read by the wave's two readers, each of whom left its entry to the other; see the write-ups.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_UpdateMapInput
addresses.no_signature: its arguments were read through its callers and not set down
addresses.comment: Once a frame from CInGameIdler::Update, before CInGameIdler_HandleInput and UpdateMapCamera, while the window is up. First, on any tab: a changed played country rescans the lists and returns to tab 0, the list box updates and the three tab frames are set. Then, only on the Current tab with a live plan of the player's chosen, the tools' mouse: tools 1 to 5 take a left press, select takes it only with Ctrl or Shift; right clicks are never taken. See section 4 of the write-up.
